requirement_text: Admin shall be able to schedule matches by specifying the date, time, and location, as well as reschedule matches due to bad weather conditions.
user_story: As a league admin, I want to schedule matches by date, time and location and reschedule them for bad weather, so that games go ahead at suitable times.
technical_task: Implement match scheduling with date, time and location fields and a reschedule option used when weather is bad.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new match, when the admin enters a date, a time and a location, then the match is scheduled.
Given a scheduled match affected by bad weather conditions, when the admin reschedules it, then the match has the new date and time.

requirement_text: A Platform Administrator shall be able to hide public datasets.
user_story: As a platform administrator, I want to hide public datasets, so that they are no longer visible to the public.
technical_task: Give Platform Administrators a way to switch a public dataset to hidden.
acceptance_criteria: Given a public dataset, when a Platform Administrator hides it, then the public can no longer see it.
Given a user who is not a Platform Administrator, when the user tries to hide a public dataset, then it is not hidden.

requirement_text: The product shall be free of computer viruses.
user_story: As a user, I want the product to be free of computer viruses, so that my computer is not harmed.
technical_task: Scan the product and its deliverables for computer viruses before release.
acceptance_criteria: Given the product package, when it is scanned with a virus scanner before release, then no computer virus is found.
Given a computer virus is found in the product, when it is reported, then the product is not released.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which scanner is used is not stated.

requirement_text: User shall have the option to input using either touch screen or keypad methods.
user_story: As a user, I want to enter input by touch screen or keypad, so that I can use whichever suits me.
technical_task: Accept input from both a touch screen and a keypad.
acceptance_criteria: Given a touch screen, when the user enters input on it, then the input is accepted.
Given a keypad, when the user enters input on it, then the input is accepted.

requirement_text: System shall ensure accessibility across all major web browsers available on the market without restrictions.
rationale: "All major web browsers" and "without restrictions" are not defined.
clarification_questions: Which browsers count as "major" and which versions?
What does "without restrictions" mean in testable terms?

requirement_text: The system shall provide separate interfaces for students, faculty, and administrators.
user_story: As a user, I want separate interfaces for students, faculty and administrators, so that each group sees what it needs.
technical_task: Build three separate interfaces: one for students, one for faculty and one for administrators.
acceptance_criteria: Given a student, when the student logs in, then the student interface is shown.
Given a faculty member or an administrator, when the person logs in, then the faculty interface or the administrator interface is shown respectively.
rationale: Role assumed: user of any of the three groups.

requirement_text: Settings shall include notification settings, app language change, and help menu.
user_story: As a user, I want settings for notifications, app language and a help menu, so that I can adjust the app.
technical_task: Create a Settings screen that includes notification settings, language change and a help menu.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Settings screen, when the user opens it, then notification settings, app language change and a help menu are available.
Given the app language setting, when the user changes the language, then the app is displayed in the chosen language.

requirement_text: The NE shall keep track of the grouping of physical processors into virtual groups. This mapping is contained in the Configuration Table (CT).
requirement_text_raw: The NE shall (3.2.2.2.1) keep track of the grouping of physical processors into virtual groups. This mapping is contained in the Configuration Table (CT).
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the NE to keep track of how physical processors are grouped into virtual groups, using the Configuration Table (CT), so that the grouping is known.
technical_task: Maintain the mapping of physical processors to virtual groups in the NE and hold it in the Configuration Table (CT).
acceptance_criteria: Given physical processors grouped into virtual groups, when the NE operates, then it tracks the grouping.
Given the grouping, when the Configuration Table (CT) is read, then it contains the mapping.

requirement_text: The responsible organization shall define the specific details of the test protocol, considering the intended purpose of this evaluation, battery system design and location, facility availability, and the safety of test personnel and equipment.
user_story: As a project lead, I want the responsible organization to define the test protocol details, considering purpose, battery system design and location, facility availability and safety, so that tests are planned properly.
technical_task: Have the responsible organization define the specific details of the test protocol, taking into account the intended purpose, battery system design and location, facility availability and the safety of test personnel and equipment.
acceptance_criteria: Given an evaluation to be performed, when the test protocol is prepared, then the responsible organization defines its specific details.
Given the test protocol, when it is reviewed, then it takes into account purpose, battery system design and location, facility availability and safety of personnel and equipment.

requirement_text: Administrator shall review and approve/deny leave requests.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to review and approve or deny leave requests, so that leave is managed.
technical_task: Provide a review screen for leave requests with approve and deny actions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a leave request, when the administrator approves it, then the request is marked approved.
Given a leave request, when the administrator denies it, then the request is marked denied.

requirement_text: User shall be able to create purchase orders for medicines from authorized distributors, specifying details like quantity and expiration dates.
user_story: As a pharmacist, I want to create purchase orders for medicines from authorized distributors with quantity and expiration dates, so that I can restock.
technical_task: Provide a purchase order form for medicines that records the authorized distributor, quantity and expiration dates.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized distributor, when the user creates a purchase order for medicines, then the order is saved.
Given a purchase order, when it is created, then it records details such as quantity and expiration dates.
rationale: Role assumed: pharmacist. "Details like" means more details may exist.

requirement_text: Login failures valid authentication and log outs are also logged .
requirement_text_raw: Login failures  valid authentication  and log outs are also logged .
user_story: As a security auditor, I want login failures, valid authentications and log outs logged, so that access can be reviewed.
technical_task: Record login failures, successful authentications and log outs in the log.
acceptance_criteria: Given a failed login, when it happens, then it is logged.
Given a valid authentication or a log out, when it happens, then it is logged.

requirement_text: Lettering of the supplier 's name and supplier identification shall be designed smaller than the OEM-identification.
user_story: As an OEM, I want the supplier's lettering and identification designed smaller than the OEM identification, so that the OEM brand is dominant.
technical_task: Design the supplier name lettering and supplier identification smaller than the OEM identification.
acceptance_criteria: Given the product marking, when the supplier's name lettering is measured, then it is smaller than the OEM identification.
Given the product marking, when the supplier identification is measured, then it is smaller than the OEM identification.

requirement_text: User shall specify desired report criteria, and the system shall display the report accordingly.
user_story: As a user, I want to specify report criteria and see the report accordingly, so that I get the information I need.
technical_task: Let the user enter report criteria and display a report built from them.
acceptance_criteria: Given report criteria entered by the user, when the user requests the report, then the report is displayed according to the criteria.
Given different criteria, when the user requests the report again, then the report changes accordingly.

requirement_text: Social travel application shall allow users to select, define, record, or import routes.
user_story: As a traveler, I want to select, define, record or import routes, so that I can plan and share them.
technical_task: Provide functions to select, define, record and import routes in the social travel application.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application, when the user selects or defines a route, then the route is saved.
Given the application, when the user records or imports a route, then the route is added.

requirement_text: An administrator chooses to maintain the standards list for immunizations diagnoses allowable drugs or allowable physical services .
requirement_text_raw: An administrator chooses to maintain the standards list for immunizations   diagnoses   allowable drugs   or allowable physical services .
user_story: As an administrator, I want to maintain the standards list for immunizations, diagnoses, allowable drugs and allowable physical services, so that clinicians use approved values.
technical_task: Provide maintenance of the standards lists for immunizations, diagnoses, allowable drugs and allowable physical services.
acceptance_criteria: Given a standards list, when the administrator adds or changes an entry, then the list is updated.
Given the lists, when the administrator opens them, then lists for immunizations, diagnoses, allowable drugs and allowable physical services are available.

requirement_text: User shall login to access the examiner portal.
user_story: As an examiner, I want to log in to the examiner portal, so that I can access my functions.
technical_task: Require login to access the examiner portal.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid examiner login, when the user logs in, then the examiner portal opens.
Given no login, when the user tries to open the examiner portal, then access is refused.

requirement_text: User shall be able to remove items from their listings by tapping Remove Item.
user_story: As a seller, I want to remove items from my listings by tapping Remove Item, so that sold items disappear.
technical_task: Add a Remove Item control that deletes an item from the user's listings.
acceptance_criteria: Given an item in the user's listings, when the user taps Remove Item, then the item is removed from the listings.
Given an item removed, when the listings are viewed, then it is no longer shown.

requirement_text: The system must be recoverable in case of any failures or problems.
user_story: As an administrator, I want the system to be recoverable after failures or problems, so that service can be restored.
technical_task: Provide recovery procedures that restore the system after a failure or problem.
acceptance_criteria: Given a failure, when recovery is performed, then the system is restored to working order.
Given a problem, when recovery is performed, then the system resumes operation.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. "Any" failure cannot be covered completely, so the criteria describe recovery in general.

requirement_text: User shall be able to copy items by selecting them and clicking the "Copy" button.
user_story: As a user, I want to copy items by selecting them and clicking Copy, so that I can duplicate them quickly.
technical_task: Add a Copy button that duplicates the selected items.
acceptance_criteria: Given selected items, when the user clicks the Copy button, then copies of the items are created.
Given no selected items, when the user clicks the Copy button, then no copy is made.

requirement_text: Sub-apps and their launchers in the main app shall be deleted by a qualified programmer.
user_story: As a qualified programmer, I want to delete sub-apps and their launchers from the main app, so that unused ones are removed.
technical_task: Allow only a qualified programmer to delete sub-apps together with their launchers in the main app.
acceptance_criteria: Given a qualified programmer, when the programmer deletes a sub-app, then the sub-app and its launcher are removed from the main app.
Given a user who is not a qualified programmer, when the user tries to delete a sub-app, then it is not deleted.

requirement_text: The system shall comply with relevant data privacy regulations based on usage (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA).
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want the system to comply with the data privacy regulations that apply to its use, such as GDPR or HIPAA, so that we meet legal duties.
technical_task: Identify the data privacy regulations that apply to the system's usage, for example GDPR and HIPAA, and implement what they require.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system's usage, when applicable data privacy regulations such as GDPR or HIPAA are identified, then the system meets their requirements.
Given a regulation that applies, when the system is reviewed, then no requirement of that regulation is violated.
rationale: Role assumed: compliance officer. The regulations' content is not given.

requirement_text: System shall respond to citizen inquiries with minimal turnaround time.
clarification_questions: What turnaround time counts as "minimal" for citizen inquiries?
Which kinds of inquiries does this cover?

requirement_text: For details concerning Software Quality Gates see separate chapter.
rationale: The sentence only points to another chapter.
clarification_questions: What do the Software Quality Gates require?
Is the separate chapter part of this requirement?

requirement_text: The FTSS API shall define a methodology for segregating and managing congruent aligned, congruent initialized, and non-congruent memory such that congruent aligned memory is aligned and congruent initialized memory is initialized during channel recovery. Non-congruent memory is not modified during realignment.
requirement_text_raw: 1.     The FTSS API shall [SRS046] define a methodology for segregating and managing congruent aligned, congruent initialized, and non-congruent memory such that congruent aligned memory is aligned and congruent initialized memory is initialized during channel recovery.  Non-congruent memory is not modified during realignment.
user_story: As a software developer, I want the FTSS API to define how congruent aligned, congruent initialized and non-congruent memory are segregated and managed, so that memory behaves correctly during recovery and realignment.
technical_task: Define in the FTSS API a methodology for segregating and managing congruent aligned, congruent initialized and non-congruent memory, with aligned and initialized memory handled during channel recovery and non-congruent memory left unmodified during realignment.
acceptance_criteria: Given channel recovery, when the methodology is applied, then congruent aligned memory is aligned and congruent initialized memory is initialized.
Given realignment, when the methodology is applied, then non-congruent memory is not modified.

requirement_text: Administrator shall be able to remove videos by entering the video name and receive confirmation of successful removal.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to remove videos by entering the video name and get a confirmation, so that I know the removal worked.
technical_task: Add a removal function that deletes a video by name and shows a confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing video, when the administrator enters its name and removes it, then the video is removed.
Given a video removed, when the removal completes, then a confirmation of successful removal is shown.

requirement_text: The system shall adhere to relevant banking and financial industry regulations, including Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) requirements.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want the system to adhere to banking and financial regulations, including Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) requirements, so that we stay compliant.
technical_task: Implement the KYC and AML requirements and other relevant banking and financial industry regulations.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new customer, when the account is opened, then the Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements are applied.
Given financial transactions, when they are processed, then the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) requirements are applied.
rationale: Role assumed: compliance officer. Other relevant regulations are not listed.

requirement_text: The LHCP views his or her message inbox.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to view my message inbox, so that I can read my messages.
technical_task: Provide a message inbox view for the LHCP.
acceptance_criteria: Given an LHCP with messages, when the LHCP opens the message inbox, then the messages are shown.
Given an LHCP with no messages, when the LHCP opens the inbox, then it is empty.

requirement_text: TCS shall notify the operator when AV performance parameters are out of limits.
user_story: As an operator, I want the TCS to notify me when AV performance parameters are out of limits, so that I can react.
technical_task: Send a notification to the operator whenever an AV performance parameter leaves its limits.
acceptance_criteria: Given an AV performance parameter is out of limits, when the TCS detects it, then the operator is notified.
Given all AV performance parameters are within limits, when the TCS checks them, then no notification is sent.
rationale: Role assumed: operator. The limits are not given.

requirement_text: System shall have a logical interface for ease of use and common tasks.
user_story: As a user, I want a logical interface for common tasks, so that I can use the system easily.
technical_task: Arrange the interface so that common tasks follow a logical flow.
acceptance_criteria: Given a common task, when the user performs it, then the steps follow a logical order.
Given the interface, when it is reviewed, then common tasks are reachable without detours.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Logical" and "ease of use" are not measured.

requirement_text: System administrators shall have control over dropdown lists and list boxes throughout the site.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want control over dropdown lists and list boxes throughout the site, so that I can keep their values current.
technical_task: Let administrators edit the values of every dropdown list and list box on the site.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dropdown list or list box, when the administrator adds or removes a value, then the list reflects the change.
Given dropdown lists across the site, when the administrator edits one, then the edit is available everywhere that list is used.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to retrieve data about mapped elements from the database.
user_story: As a system, I want to retrieve data about mapped elements from the database, so that mapped elements can be displayed.
technical_task: Query the database for data about mapped elements.
acceptance_criteria: Given mapped elements in the database, when the system requests data about them, then the data is retrieved.
Given a mapped element, when its data is retrieved, then it matches the database record.
rationale: Role assumed: the system itself, since no user is named.

requirement_text: The system shall function as a high availability computer for real-time tasks including correlation, hardware management, and remote updates.
user_story: As an observatory engineer, I want the system to work as a high availability computer for correlation, hardware management and remote updates, so that these real-time tasks keep running.
technical_task: Provide the system as a high availability computer that handles real-time tasks including correlation, hardware management and remote updates.
acceptance_criteria: Given a real-time correlation task, when the system runs it, then the task is carried out.
Given hardware management or a remote update, when it is requested, then the system carries it out.
rationale: Role assumed: observatory engineer. "High availability" is not quantified.

requirement_text: System shall ensure the security of user accounts, employing measures such as encryption, password complexity requirements, and protection against brute-force attacks.
user_story: As a user, I want my account secured with encryption, password complexity requirements and protection against brute-force attacks, so that nobody can take it over.
technical_task: Secure user accounts with encryption, password complexity rules and protection against brute-force attacks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user sets a password, when it does not meet the complexity requirements, then it is rejected.
Given repeated failed login attempts, when a brute-force attack is detected, then further attempts are blocked.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Such as" means other measures are possible.

requirement_text: User shall select desired data format and export criteria, and the system shall export data accordingly.
user_story: As a user, I want to choose a data format and export criteria and have the data exported accordingly, so that I get the data I need.
technical_task: Offer data export with a selectable format and selectable export criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Given a chosen data format and export criteria, when the user exports, then the data is exported in that format and matches the criteria.
Given different export criteria, when the user exports again, then the exported data changes accordingly.

requirement_text: Redundancy Management shall , during memory alignment, configure the NE to mask out the processor being re-synchronized.
requirement_text_raw: Redundancy Management shall [SRS281], during memory alignment, configure the NE to mask out the processor being re-synchronized.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Redundancy Management to mask out the processor being re-synchronized during memory alignment, so that it does not disturb the NE.
technical_task: During memory alignment, configure the NE to mask out the processor that is being re-synchronized.
acceptance_criteria: Given memory alignment is in progress, when a processor is being re-synchronized, then Redundancy Management configures the NE to mask it out.
Given memory alignment is not in progress, when no processor is being re-synchronized, then no masking is required by this rule.

requirement_text: Upon start of the roll program, roll information shall be displayed on the instructor’s Pocket PC within 10 seconds.
user_story: As an instructor, I want roll information on my Pocket PC within 10 seconds of starting the roll program, so that I can begin right away.
technical_task: Display the roll information on the instructor's Pocket PC no later than 10 seconds after the roll program starts.
acceptance_criteria: Given the instructor starts the roll program, when 10 seconds have passed, then the roll information is displayed on the Pocket PC.
Given a display that takes longer than 10 seconds, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role stated: instructor. The garbled apostrophe was read as "instructor's".

requirement_text: The drug desired to be prescribed is checked against the patient's drug allergies.
user_story: As a physician, I want the drug I want to prescribe checked against the patient's drug allergies, so that I avoid harmful prescriptions.
technical_task: Check each drug selected for prescribing against the patient's recorded drug allergies.
acceptance_criteria: Given a drug the patient is allergic to, when the physician selects it for prescribing, then the allergy is detected.
Given a drug the patient is not allergic to, when the physician selects it, then no allergy is reported.

requirement_text: Administrator shall be able to check the status of all books, including whether they have been issued or reserved, and view their details.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to check the status of all books, whether issued or reserved, and view their details, so that I know where each book is.
technical_task: Provide a status view of all books showing issued and reserved state and a details view.
acceptance_criteria: Given books in the library, when the administrator opens the status view, then each book's status is shown, including whether it is issued or reserved.
Given a book in the list, when the administrator selects it, then its details are displayed.

requirement_text: The system should be accessible on various devices (mobile app implies mobile accessibility).
user_story: As a user, I want the system accessible on various devices, so that I can use it on my mobile as well.
technical_task: Make the system usable on several device types, including mobile.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mobile device, when the user opens the system, then it is accessible.
Given another supported device type, when the user opens the system, then it is accessible.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The devices are only implied by the mobile app; the exact list is not given.

requirement_text: The software assumes the use of a tool like Tomcat for connecting web pages and the database.
rationale: The sentence states an assumption about tooling and does not require specific behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is Tomcat required, or is it only an example ("a tool like Tomcat")?
What must connect the web pages and the database?

requirement_text: Traceability needs to be ensure for the product, further details via Quality workshop.
rationale: The sentence defers the details to a workshop and gives no testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: What does traceability need to cover for the product?
What will the Quality workshop decide?

requirement_text: User shall be able to purchase credits using credit card or PayPal account.
user_story: As a customer, I want to buy credits with a credit card or a PayPal account, so that I can pay the way I prefer.
technical_task: Offer credit card and PayPal account as payment methods for buying credits.
acceptance_criteria: Given a credit card, when the user buys credits with it, then the purchase is completed.
Given a PayPal account, when the user buys credits with it, then the purchase is completed.

requirement_text: Each flight NE shall be conduction-cooled.
requirement_text_raw: Each flight NE shall (3.2.3.1.2.12) be conduction-cooled.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want each flight NE to be conduction-cooled, so that it needs no airflow.
technical_task: Design each flight NE for conduction cooling.
acceptance_criteria: Given a flight NE, when its cooling design is reviewed, then it is conduction-cooled.
Given a flight NE in operation, when its cooling is inspected, then it does not depend on convection or forced airflow.
rationale: Role assumed: hardware engineer. The second criterion is an interpretation of "conduction-cooled".

requirement_text: The user shall be able to cancel booked tickets if they need to change their travel dates.
user_story: As a traveler, I want to cancel booked tickets when I need to change my travel dates, so that I can rebook.
technical_task: Provide a cancel function for booked tickets.
acceptance_criteria: Given a booked ticket, when the user cancels it, then the booking is cancelled.
Given a cancelled ticket, when the user views their bookings, then it is no longer active.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to create proxy Data Packages for reliable data sources.
user_story: As a data publisher, I want to create proxy Data Packages for reliable data sources, so that I can reference them without copying.
technical_task: Support creation of proxy Data Packages that point to reliable data sources.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reliable data source, when the user creates a proxy Data Package for it, then the Data Package is created.
Given a proxy Data Package, when it is opened, then it refers to the data source.
rationale: Role assumed: data publisher. What "reliable" means is not defined.

requirement_text: The restaurant owner login system must always prevent unauthorized access by notifying users of failed login attempts with non-existent accounts.
user_story: As a restaurant owner, I want to be notified of failed login attempts with non-existent accounts, so that I can spot unauthorized access attempts.
technical_task: Notify users when a login attempt fails because the account does not exist.
acceptance_criteria: Given a login attempt with a non-existent account, when it fails, then the user is notified of the failed attempt.
Given a login attempt with an existing account and correct credentials, when it succeeds, then no failed-attempt notification is sent.
rationale: Role stated: restaurant owner. "Always prevent unauthorized access" cannot be guaranteed; the criteria test the notification.

requirement_text: System shall be able to process transaction requests on a device and send a message indicating the success or failure of the transaction.
user_story: As a user, I want transaction requests processed on my device and a message telling me whether they succeeded, so that I know the outcome.
technical_task: Process transaction requests on a device and send a success or failure message.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transaction request, when it is processed on the device, then a message states that it succeeded.
Given a transaction request that fails, when it ends, then a message states that it failed.

requirement_text: Further details on proposed PWM strategy is provided in the SW Specification.
rationale: The sentence only points to another specification.
clarification_questions: What does the SW Specification say about the PWM strategy?
Is the referenced specification part of this requirement?

requirement_text: The system shall allow camp administrators to suspend campers for behavioral issues.
user_story: As a camp administrator, I want to suspend campers for behavioral issues, so that I can manage conduct.
technical_task: Provide a suspend function for campers that administrators can apply for behavioral issues.
acceptance_criteria: Given a camper with behavioral issues, when the camp administrator suspends the camper, then the camper is marked as suspended.
Given a suspended camper, when the camp is administered, then the camper's suspension is shown.
